title: Smart Bots In The Lobby
description: A second in-process bot kind, the rule bot, next to the random bot. It plays like the random bot but has simple opinions on the board: it activates systems whose planets it can take with the carriers and ground forces it can reach, invades Mecatol Rex when it can pay the custodians, only enters space combats it clearly wins and retreats from ones it clearly loses, lands enough ground forces to win, builds the most useful unit per resource when short of units, pays with the planet that wastes least and accepts only trades that are slightly in its favour. Everything else (strategy cards, technology, agendas, action cards) stays random. In the lobby the host gets 'Add rule bot' and 'Fill empty seats with rule bots' when the server lists the 'smart' kind; smart seats carry a 'Rule bot' badge. Synthetic: the real lobby components against a mocked server, regenerated by npm run screenshots -- BY.

shots.heading: Host: both bot kinds
shots.caption: Four buttons above the seat list: add or fill with random bots, add or fill with rule bots. The hint says what each kind does; neither needs a password.

shots.heading: One rule bot seated
shots.caption: The seat reads 'Rule bot 1' with a 'Rule bot' badge and 'Plays itself'; it is ready from the start and can be removed like a random bot.

shots.heading: A random and a rule bot at one table
shots.caption: One 'Add random bot', then 'Fill empty seats with rule bots'. Each badge names its kind; with no seat open the add buttons disappear.

shots.heading: A server without rule bots
shots.caption: When the lobby's bot_kinds lists only 'random' (an older server), only the random bot buttons appear.

shots.heading: Phone: four touch sized buttons
shots.caption: 390 px wide. The buttons stack, are at least 40 px tall and stay inside the screen (asserted).

shots.heading: Phone: filled with rule bots
shots.caption: Three rule bots fill the open seats; the page does not scroll sideways (asserted).

shots.heading: Guest view
shots.caption: Another player sees which seats are rule bots but gets no add or fill buttons.
